title: WALTEUR ontology-lite glossary
description: A FILE-SCALE TYPED ENTITY GLOSSARY (walteur-kit/ontology.json) that the gates LINT against — NOT a second retrieval index. graphify stays the ONE retrieval brain (one-brain law). Each entity is a typed domain noun with optional aliases and a one-line definition; ontology-lint.sh WARNs (advisory, exit 0) when a PRD/PLAN/ADR references a capitalized domain noun that no entity name/aka defines. Schema-light by design: a glossary, not a knowledge model.

note.description: free-text reminder that this is a glossary, not an index (one-brain law)

entities.description: the typed domain vocabulary; each name should be unique (case-insensitive)

type.description: the entity class — schema-light, free string, but a small stable vocabulary is encouraged

aka.description: accepted aliases / synonyms / casings that resolve to this entity (lint treats these as defined too)

definition.description: one-line meaning; what this noun denotes in THIS project's domain
